name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Position a stable bench across the Smith machine and rest your shoulder blades against its edge.
Set the bar across your hip crease and plant your feet flat.
Unrack the bar by rotating it slightly, tuck your chin gently forward, and brace your core.
Drive through your heels to thrust your hips smoothly upward until your torso and thighs form a straight horizontal line with shins vertical.
Squeeze your glutes strongly at the top, then lower your hips slowly back toward the floor under control.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down and look forward rather than arching your lower back at lockout.
Adjust your foot distance so your knees bend cleanly to 90 degrees at the top of the thrust.
